**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**

### Build-Your-Own Framework

**Base price:** $6,500 (Lite configuration)

**Per-dimension upgrade pricing:**
- Depth: Light → Standard **+$3,500** · Standard → Deep **+$5,500**

- Pace: Sprint → Standard **+$1,500** · Standard → Extended **+$2,500**
- Format: Internal → Designed PDF **+$1,500** · Designed → Handoff kit **+$3,000**
- Support: Async → Standard **+$2,000** · Standard → Priority **+$3,500**
- Post: None → 30-day Q&A **+$1,500** · 30-day → 90-day embed **+$4,500**

**Floor:** $6,500 (Lite as-is; nothing ships below this)
**Ceiling:** $28,000 — above this, auto-route to Premium (better value) or scope a custom engagement

**Configurator must enforce:**
- All invalid combinations from Part 2
- Cannot select Post-engagement embed without upgrading Support to Standard or Priority first
- Naming ($6,500 breadth jump) forces a pace check — surface Extended as recommended

**Flagship-protection rule:**
- BYO to Core config sums to ~$17,000 (Core priced at $15,000 = **$2,000 savings**)
- BYO to Premium config sums to ~$36,500 (Premium priced at $32,000 = **$4,500 savings**)

|---|---|---|---|

| **Nutrition Scope** | How prescriptive the food side is | Guidelines / Macros / Full meal plan + adjustments | Full meal plan requires Biweekly+ Support |
| **Specialty Track** *(domain-specific)* | Event / population overlay | None / Physique prep / Strength peaking / Postpartum / Masters / Travel-heavy exec | Physique prep + Strength peaking require Weekly Support and Fully custom Depth |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Template-adjusted Depth + Weekly live sessions (coach time doesn't match program investment)
- Full meal plan + Monthly Support (plan goes stale before revision)
- Physique prep or Strength peaking + Monthly Support
- Same-day+weekends Access + more than 20 active clients (internal capacity rule)
- Biometrics-driven Depth without wearable or weekly weigh-in intake

## Part 3 — Three Tiers + Build-Your-Own

Renamed in coaching vernacular: **Self-Guided+**, **Signature Coaching**, **Private Client**.

| Tier | Configuration | Positioning | Pricing Anchor |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Self-Guided+ (Lite)** | Depth: Template-adjusted · Support: Monthly · Access: Async 48hr · Live: None · Nutrition: Guidelines · Specialty: None | For the self-motivated lifter who wants a coach's eyes on the plan monthly, not a hand held daily. | **+$A/mo** — priced ~30–40% of flagship; anchored above app-based coaching (~$50–150/mo) to signal real human review |
| **Signature Coaching (Core, flagship)** | Depth: Fully custom · Support: Biweekly · Access: Async 24hr · Live: 1x 30-min/mo · Nutrition: Macros · Specialty: optional | For the client who wants a real coaching relationship without the price of an in-person trainer. | **+$B/mo** — anchored *below* the sum of Self-Guided+ plus every upgrade to reach this config (flagship discount); anchored against local 2x/week in-person training cost |
| **Private Client (Premium)** | Depth: Fully custom + biometrics · Support: Weekly · Access: Same-day + weekends · Live: 2x calls or 1 live session · Nutrition: Full meal plan · Specialty: any | For competitors, execs, and clients who need a coach embedded in their week — capped roster. | **+$C/mo** — anchored against boutique in-person coaching + nutritionist stack (~2–3x flagship); scarcity-anchored via client cap |

### Build-Your-Own Framework

- **Base price:** Self-Guided+ config at **+$A/mo**
- **Per-dimension upgrades:** each dimension level-up adds a fixed increment (Depth upgrade, Support upgrade, Access upgrade, Live Contact upgrade, Nutrition upgrade, Specialty Track flat fee, Add-ons à la carte)
- **Floor:** Base price (**+$A/mo**) — no config cheaper; sub-floor requests routed to a group program or self-serve template
- **Ceiling:** Any config that includes Weekly Support + Fully custom + biometrics + Specialty Track auto-routes to **Private Client** (do not sell BYO above ceiling — protects roster cap and flagship)
- **Configurator dependencies to enforce:** all invalid combinations from Part 2, plus: any two "max-level" dimensions together require routing to Signature Coaching quote flow (prevents accidental Premium-equivalent at BYO pricing)
- **Flagship-protection rule:** BYO sum to reach Signature Coaching's exact configuration must price **10–20% above** Signature's flagship rate. Same for Private Client vs. its BYO-equivalent. The named tiers must always be the rational buy when the config matches.

This is out of scope for this skill.

**Why:** Intelligent Clay productizes *services* — turning consulting, coaching, agency, and done-for-you work into configurable tiers. Your offering is already a product: SaaS with per-seat pricing and tiered plans. The modularization problem is fundamentally different.

**What you likely want instead:**

- **Packaging/pricing strategy for SaaS** — feature gating, seat vs. usage vs. value metric decisions, Pro→Enterprise gap analysis. This is a pricing/PMM discipline (see work by Kyle Poyar, Patrick Campbell, Elena Verna).
- **Product roadmap / discovery** — if the question is *which* features to build or unbundle, that's PM territory.
- **Enterprise plan structuring** — if the specific pain is that Enterprise is a black box and every deal is bespoke, that's the closest adjacency to what I do. A services-productization skill *can* apply to the human-delivered layer around Enterprise (onboarding, CSM, implementation, SLAs).

**One question that would change my answer:**

Is the actual pain the *software tiers*, or is it the *services wrapped around Enterprise* (implementation, onboarding, custom integrations, dedicated CSM)? If it's the latter — those services are clay, and I can modularize them into Lite/Core/Premium implementation packages plus BYO. Say the word and I'll run the blueprint on that layer.

This is out of scope for me.

Intelligent Clay productizes **services** — turning consulting, coaching, agency, freelance, or done-for-you work into tiered, configurable offerings. Handmade leather wallets are a **physical product**, which is already modular in a different sense: SKUs, variants, and bundles.

**What you actually want is probably one of these:**

1. **SKU/variant architecture** — wallet styles × leather types × hardware × monogramming. A product configurator, not a service decomposition.
2. **Bundle/tier logic** — starter (wallet), gift set (wallet + cardholder), full leather goods set (wallet + cardholder + keychain).
3. **Made-to-order productization** — *this* is where I could help, but only if you're offering a **custom design service** around the wallets (consultation call, bespoke pattern design, monogramming consultation, etc.). That service layer is clay.

**Where I could actually help you:**

- If you offer (or want to offer) a **bespoke wallet design service** — 1-on-1 consultation, custom pattern, choice of hides, etc. — that's a service and I can decompose it into Lite/Core/Premium + build-your-own.
- If you want to add a **leather care / repair / restoration service** to your product line — same thing, that's productizable service work.
- If you teach **leatherworking workshops or courses** — that's a service (education) and modularizable.

**If you want to stay on the physical-product side**, you need a different tool: an e-commerce merchandising or product-line-architecture framework, not this one.

Which direction do you want to go?

| **Support** | Rounds + iteration window | 2 rounds / Unlimited-in-scope / Unlimited + 90-day post-launch | Unlimited+90 requires Volume≥Medium |
| **Vertical Overlay** *(add-on)* | Regulatory/compliance-aware creative (fintech, health, etc.) | Off / On | Adds fixed monthly premium; requires Depth≥40% |

**Invalid combinations the configurator must block:**
- Motion-only Discipline Mix at any tier
- Depth 70%+ with Volume High
- Rush pace with Depth 70%+
- Direct-to-principal access below $40K/mo equivalent
- Unlimited+90 support with Volume Low
- Vertical Overlay with Depth 20%
